title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2021 · Fmge Mini Test 2

questions.stem: A patient with parathyroid deficiency, 10 days after inadvertent damage to the parathyroid glands during thyroid surgery would probably have:
questions.stemHtml: A patient with parathyroid deficiency, 10 days after inadvertent damage to the parathyroid glands during thyroid surgery would probably have:

options.label: A
options.text: High plasma phosphate, High Ca2+ levels and tetanus.

options.label: B
options.text: Low plasma Ca2+ level, tetany, and Trousseau sign.

options.label: C
options.text: Low plasma phosphate and high Ca2+ levels and bone demineralization.

options.label: D
options.text: Increased muscular excitability, a high plasma Ca2+ level, and bone demineralization
